fields.description: Choose whether checkout creates Sales Invoice or POS Invoice. ZATCA/e-invoicing behaviour is configured in ZATCA settings when that app is installed.
fields.label: Invoice Posting Type

fields.description: Apply Saudi VAT on POS and booking invoices.
fields.label: Enable VAT on Invoices

fields.description: When checked, service prices in Beauty Cloud are treated as VAT-inclusive (typical for Saudi retail). Uncheck if prices are entered excluding VAT.
fields.label: Prices Include VAT

fields.description: Output VAT account used on sales invoices. Auto-detected on setup if blank.
fields.label: VAT Account

fields.description: ERPNext sales tax template applied to Beauty Cloud invoices.
fields.label: Sales Taxes Template

fields.description: SMS OTP for customer booking is optional. Enable when an SMS provider is configured.
fields.label: Enable SMS OTP

fields.description: Send one-time verification codes by email when the customer provides an email address.
fields.label: Enable Email OTP

fields.description: Email customers a booking confirmation with check-in QR code when an appointment is confirmed.
fields.label: Send Booking Confirmation Email

fields.description: Optional sender address for booking emails. Leave blank to use the site default outgoing email.
fields.label: Booking From Email

fields.description: How long the OTP remains valid after it is sent.
fields.label: OTP Expiry (Minutes)

fields.description: Maximum verification attempts allowed per OTP request.
fields.label: OTP Max Attempts

fields.description: When enabled, customers must pay online before the appointment is confirmed.
fields.label: Require Payment at Booking

fields.description: When enabled, reception/beautician cannot start or complete a service until payment is collected (Cash at reception/kiosk or POS). Check-in only confirms arrival.
fields.label: Require Payment Before Service

fields.description: When enabled, the self-service kiosk collects payment (cash/card modes allowed for kiosk) before the booking is confirmed.
fields.label: Require Payment at Kiosk

fields.description: When enabled, the guest must be paid (or deposit paid) before reception can check them in.
fields.label: Require Payment Before Check-in

fields.description: When enabled, reception must scan the customer's booking QR code before check-in.
fields.label: Require QR Scan for Check-in

fields.description: When enabled, reception must enter and verify the appointment ID (e.g. BAPT-2026-00038) before check-in. Use this instead of QR when QR scan is off.
fields.label: Require Appointment ID for Check-in

fields.description: When enabled, reception must check in the guest before a beautician can start the service. Check-in is limited to reception; starting is limited to beauticians.
fields.label: Require Check-in Before Service

fields.description: When enabled, reception must issue the salon invoice at POS after check-in. Beauticians cannot start until the invoice exists.
fields.label: Require POS Invoice Before Service

fields.description: When enabled, unpaid Online and Kiosk draft appointments are automatically cancelled after the hold period below so the time slot becomes available again.
fields.label: Auto-cancel Unpaid Draft Bookings

fields.description: How long to hold the slot while the guest completes payment. After this time the draft booking is cancelled and the slot is released.
fields.label: Unpaid Draft Hold (Minutes)

fields.description: Use Frappe HR shifts, leave, and holidays when calculating bookable beautician times.
fields.label: Enable HR Schedule Integration
Schedule Source Priority
fields.options:
HR Primary
Beauty Schedule Primary
Intersect Both

fields.description: When no Shift Assignment exists, fall back to the Employee default shift from HR.
fields.label: Use Employee Default Shift

fields.description: When a Beauty Employee Schedule is saved in back office, HR Shift Assignments are created or updated automatically.
fields.label: Auto-sync Beauty Schedules to HR Shifts

fields.description: How many days ahead to maintain HR Shift Assignments from weekly Beauty Employee Schedules.
fields.label: HR Sync Horizon (Days)

fields.description: Only flagged Mode of Payment rows are offered in Beauty Cloud channels. Third-party payment API integration will use these modes later.
fields.label: Allowed Payment Methods

fields.description: Enable Telr hosted payment page for online booking checkout.
fields.label: Enable Telr Gateway

fields.description: Numeric store ID from Telr merchant dashboard.
fields.label: Telr Store ID

fields.description: When enabled, no live Telr API calls are made. Use demo payment buttons in the booking UI.
fields.label: Telr Demo Mode

fields.default: Install and configure zatca_erpgulf on this site for Saudi e-invoicing. Invoice document type above must align with ZATCA settings.
fields.label: ZATCA Note
